skill: M16 摆首妖息 生效：张嘴从左扫到右（3秒）

parameters.prompt: With her mouth held open as if exhaling, the snake-bodied woman steadily sweeps her head from facing screen left to facing screen right at an even speed over the whole clip, ending exactly in the pose of the last frame. Only the head and neck turn; the mouth stays open. Keep the same snake-bodied woman, face, high black bun, gold hair ornament, long hair, red-black scale armour and pale belly scales. The coiled snake body and tail tip stay in place. Exactly two arms. She does not move across the frame, turn the whole body or mirror. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, breath, fire, smoke, mist, liquid, spray, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shadow or text.
